classificationReason: Discusses the rare quality shared by upcoming Broadway revivals (A Few Good Men and The Sound of Music) of being stage originals eclipsed by their film adaptations. No first-hand opinion on either production — purely anticipatory/analytical commentary. A Few Good Men is selected as the primary focus as it receives the more detailed treatment (noting that many people don't know it originated as a play).
